name: Word By Word XR
summary:
Word By Word is a calm, hands-on way to practise a language in mixed reality. A sentence appears as word tiles in your room. Pick the words up with your hands, place them in the right order, and hear the finished sentence spoken aloud.

16 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Albanian, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch, Polish, Russian, Greek, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish and Czech.

500 SENTENCES PER LANGUAGE
Each language has its own path of 500 sentences across five levels: easy, medium,
